# Q3 2026 Operating Brief

## Executive summary

Q3 was a solid quarter financially: revenue of $720,000 against spend of
$464,000 produced an operating surplus of $256,000, a ~35.6% margin. Support
closed 93.7% of the 1,250 tickets opened in the quarter, and security
resolved 95.0% of the 80 incidents it detected. The delivery plan that
kicked off October 5 is on track, with launch landing October 23 once
weekends and the company holiday are correctly excluded from the business-day
schedule. Three of the four source packets contained a stated summary figure
that did not match its own underlying data; see Notes for details on each
and which value this brief relies on.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Q3 revenue | $720,000 |
| Q3 spend | $464,000 |
| Operating surplus | $256,000 |
| Support close rate | 93.7% |
| Launch date | 2026-10-23 |
| Security resolution rate | 95.0% |

## Notes

**Finance — spend total mismatch.** The itemized spend categories (Payroll
$286,400 + Infrastructure $81,750 + Contractors $64,200 + Facilities
$31,650) sum to $464,000, but the finance packet's own summary line states
Q3 spend as $463,250 — a $750 gap. This brief uses the $464,000 line-item
sum (and the corresponding $256,000 operating surplus) since it is directly
verifiable from the reported figures; the $750 discrepancy should be
reconciled with finance.

**Support — close rate mismatch.** The support dashboard label states a
96.4% close rate, but recomputing from the reported counts (1,171 closed /
1,250 opened) gives 93.7%. This brief uses the recomputed 93.7% figure. The
3-point-plus gap is large enough that it's worth confirming how the
dashboard's stated rate was derived.

**Delivery — launch date mismatch.** The delivery packet's summary states a
launch date of 2026-10-22. Applying the stated scheduling rules (durations
are inclusive business days, the next phase starts on the next business day,
and both weekends and the October 12 company holiday are excluded) produces
a launch date of 2026-10-23 — one business day later. The stated 10-22 date
only reconciles if the October 12 holiday is disregarded in the schedule
math, which suggests the holiday was left out of that calculation. This
brief uses the recomputed 2026-10-23 date; leadership should confirm which
date is being communicated externally.

**Security — no discrepancy.** The security packet's resolution rate
(76 resolved / 80 detected = 95.0%) matches its own stated dashboard figure
exactly; no follow-up needed here.
